title: Git status always clean: the log sweeper and the worktree-only rule

chat.text: Agents logging to task.jsonl in the main tree dirty your git status. The LogSweeper that commits machine-written records already landed on 10-12 but needs a Servex restart; a Sonnet task mastermind proves what it covers, closes the gaps, writes the worktree-only workflow rule, and leaves the main tree clean.
